apiHelp.toggle: Where do I get the API Key and API Secret?
apiHelp.step1: Sign in to ERPNext and open your avatar menu, top right › My Settings.
apiHelp.step2: In the Settings tab, find API Access and select Generate Keys.
apiHelp.step3: Copy the API Secret right away: ERPNext shows it only once. The API Key stays visible in the same section.
apiHelp.note: Generating keys again stops the previous ones from working. Your user needs permissions on items, prices and stock.
apiHelp.open: Open my ERPNext in a new tab
